scope: Bounded read-only implementation review of public direction reading, canonical/public indexing, citation display projection, local-note/feedback labeling, and lexical title-screen tooling. Browser interaction and deployment acceptance remain separate gates.

resolvedFindings.problem: A string categories value was spread into character categories, silently invalidating category-balanced sampling. Reproduced with categories:cs.CV.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Strings now become one category; other values must be arrays of nonempty strings. String and invalid-type regression tests pass. Current replay array inputs were unaffected.

tests.command: node --test test/direction-reading.test.mjs test/review-citations.test.mjs test/catalog-screen.test.mjs test/notebook-navigation.test.mjs test/markdown-reading.test.mjs test/comments-client.test.mjs test/digest-reading.test.mjs

directionCoverage.primaryAndRelated: Both are retained and labeled; distinctissueentries and primarycounts are checked bytests.

independentChecks.revisionRoutes: All7 canonical revision detail routes resolve to preferred revision content; they remain audit-only in current corpus and do not enter public direction feeds. Synthetic public-revision projection test also passes.

citations.preservedSyntax: Tests cover existinglinks, code, math, escapes and unknowncitationgroups; bibliographyorder retained.

independentChecks.feedback: GitHub URL uses URLSearchParams and opens an issue form only. No automatic submission or SMTP call is added. Local notes explicitly state they are not sent, preserve localStorage key and existing failure draft retention.

lexicalReplay.comparison: Input/configSHA, matches and category-balanced sample exactly reproduced; generatedAt excluded.
lexicalReplay.boundary: 44 are lexical discovery candidates, not accepted papers or a recall estimate.

parentReportedState.browser: Parent is investigating a search dialog not opening after a dev-browser click; no browser PASS claimed by this reviewer.
parentReportedState.scientificEditorialReview: Separate content reviewer owns comparison/transfer claims in direction-reading.json.

notVerified: Live browser hydration, keyboard/focus behavior, actual390pxlayout andprint were not independently rerun here.
No fullbuild/fulltests/deployment/notification run by reviewer; parent owns those gates.
No scientific primary-source re-review of the existing reports, directionreviews orIdea conclusions.
